subject: Follow-up: short-log retention pilot for PayWell
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@paywell.com>, Carl Moss <carl.moss@paywell.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: short-log retention pilot for PayWell

Hi Ethan / Carl —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth and can move the pilot forward: 

Recap (what you told us)
- Primary ask: avoid persistent PII storage and minimize any raw request retention.
- Secondary: need demonstrable access controls, KMS/HSM proof, and support for US-only residency for pilot data.
- Scope: inference traffic (chat/generation) for a single integration (PayWell mobile API) as a 2-week functional pilot.

Our proposed pilot configuration (high level)
- Raw request retention: 24 hours max for troubleshooting (auto-delete thereafter) OR 0-retention if you prefer we never persist raw payloads in hosted mode.
- Short logs (non-PII request metadata): retained 7 days.
- Aggregated metrics/telemetry (anonymized): retained 90 days for performance/quality monitoring.
- KV cache: disabled for pilot to eliminate long-lived cached contexts.
- Residency: us-east-1 for pilot; option to use Private deployment if you require customer-managed KMS.

Attachments: I attached a simple dataflow diagram (paywell-dataflow-diagram.png) so security can see where we touch payloads.

Next steps
1) Confirm whether you want 24-hour transient retention or strict 0-retention for raw payloads.
2) Share the contacts for legal and security (we'll include them on the MOU/draft).
3) If yes to pilot, agree on a short MOU timeline (we can draft).

Proposed timeline (tentative)
- Confirm pilot scope & retention choice by 3/17
- Sign MOU by 3/19
- Tech kickoff & test vectors week of 3/23

Happy to jump on a quick 20-min call if you want to walk through the config.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: paywell-dataflow-diagram.png (image/png)]

From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@paywell.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Carl Moss <carl.moss@paywell.com>
Cc: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@paywell.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: short-log retention pilot for PayWell

Thanks Hannah — good summary. Carl and I had a quick sync and adding Alyssa (legal) to loop in terms. High level response / requirements from PayWell: 

What we need for pilot to be acceptable
- No persistent storage of PII. Prefer 0-retention of raw payloads in hosted mode. If hosted can't do 0-retention with customer-managed keys, Private deployment is an option.
- Request logs (non-PII) retained for 7 days for incident response.
- Aggregated/anonymized metrics retained up to 90 days.
- Access control evidence: role-based access lists, audit logs for all human access, and confirmation of HSM-backed KMS or equivalent.

We attached our internal retention requirements doc for reference (paywell-data-retention-reqs.pdf).

Next items we need from Redwood
1) A short written MOU or pilot statement that captures the retention settings and the limited audit scope.
2) Technical checklist (how you will redact PII, where logs are stored, backup policies).
3) SOC2 or security evidence URL for review; if SOC2 report is under NDA we can sign a mutual NDA.

Let's aim to review a draft MOU this week. Carl — can you please add any technical constraints?

—Ethan
Ethan Cole
Head of Integrations | PayWell
ethan.cole@paywell.com | +1 (212) 555-0987
[Attachment: paywell-data-retention-reqs.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@paywell.com>, Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@paywell.com>, Carl Moss <carl.moss@paywell.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@laura.bennett>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: short-log retention pilot for PayWell

Ethan / Alyssa / Carl —

Appreciate the quick reply and the attached requirements doc. Marcus (SE) and Laura (manager) are copied so we can align contract and engineering resources.

Proposed MOU language (summary) — we'll produce a short 1-page pilot MOU and a technical appendix:
- Pilot scope: up to 2 weeks, one integration, limited to non-production traffic (sanitized test vectors).
- Retention config for pilot:
  * Raw payloads: Redwood to either (a) persist raw payloads for max 24 hours then auto-delete, OR (b) configure strict "0-retention" and never persist raw payloads. Please confirm which you prefer.
  * PII handling: Redwood to perform PII redaction at ingress when 0-retention is not selected; redaction rules will be agreed in tech kickoff.
  * Request metadata (non-PII): retained for 7 days.
  * Aggregated metrics: retained for 90 days.
- Access & controls: Redwood will provide a security package including SOC2 summary, network architecture diagram, and a statement on KMS usage. If PayWell requires customer-managed KMS we will evaluate Dedicated/Private deployment options.
- Audit & logs: all human access to log storage will be captured in an auditable trail (we can keep audit trail metadata for 180 days on request; discuss below).

Action items for PayWell from our side:
1) Confirm raw payload retention choice: "0-retention" or "24h transient" by 3/17.
2) Share the contact at security who will own the technical checklist and the contact at legal for MOU redlines (Alyssa is included).
3) If customer-managed KMS is a hard requirement for hosted, confirm so we can scope Private deployment pricing.

Drafts: attaching an initial config summary (redwood-short-log-pilot-configuration.pdf) — we'll convert this to a 1-page MOU plus appendix once you confirm the retention choice.

Proposed timeline update:
- MOU draft to you by 3/13
- Sign MOU by 3/19
- Tech kickoff 3/23 (Marcus to lead)

If helpful, Marcus can join a short call tomorrow afternoon to walk through the redaction approach and KMS options.

Thanks —
Hannah
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: redwood-short-log-pilot-configuration.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@paywell.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@paywell.com>, Carl Moss <carl.moss@paywell.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@laura.bennett>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: short-log retention pilot for PayWell — draft MOU and acceptance with conditions

Hannah / Ethan / team —

Thanks for the summary and the draft config. We are supportive of a test pilot provided PayWell's minimum legal/security conditions are met. Attached is a redline of the MOU with our comments (paywell-mou-redline.docx). High-level legal items we need addressed before we sign: 

Key legal/security conditions
- Audit rights: PayWell requires limited audit rights to access logs related to our tenant (quarterly) for the duration of the pilot; Redwood must provide an audit trail of human access.
- Retention confirmation: For pilot we accept the 24-hour transient raw payload retention only if Redwood provides verifiable auto-delete logs. If Redwood can offer strict 0-retention in hosted mode with documented redaction and no backups, we prefer that.
- Indemnity and liability cap: we propose a 3x ARR cap for pilot-related incidents; please review.
- Data residency: all pilot data must remain in us-east-1. If Redwood cannot guarantee customer-managed KMS in hosted mode, PayWell will require Private deployment for pilot.
- Access logs retention: while raw payloads can be transient, PayWell needs an access log (who accessed what) retained for 180 days. Please confirm feasibility.

Technical items for Marcus / Redwood SEs
- Provide a one-page checklist of how PII redaction works, including what regex/ML methods are used and examples of redaction outputs.
- Confirm whether backups or async logs could leak raw payloads; if so we need compensating controls.

Next steps
1) Redwood to send revised 1-page MOU addressing the items above.
2) Marcus to provide the PII redaction checklist and SOC2 summary.
3) We will aim to review the redline within 3 business days after we receive the revised MOU.

Please route the revised MOU to alyssa.park@paywell.com and ethan.cole@paywell.com.

Regards,
Alyssa Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Data Protection | PayWell
alyssa.park@paywell.com | +1 (917) 555-3344
[Attachment: paywell-mou-redline.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
